results.question: What was the total revenue per year?
results.sql: SELECT strftime(order_date, '%Y') AS year, ROUND(SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items JOIN orders USING (order_id) GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

results.question: Which product category had the highest revenue in 2024? Show all categories, highest first.
results.sql: WITH category_revenue AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.category) SELECT category, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue FROM category_revenue ORDER BY revenue DESC

results.question: How many orders came in through each sales channel?
results.sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY channel

results.question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2025?
results.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

results.question: Which country has the most customers? List all countries with their number of customers.
results.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC
